description: This file defines the 'Details' feature within the 'Profiles' section, including a query, validator, and handler for retrieving profile details based on a username.

classes.name: Details.Query
classes.description: A request object containing a username, implements IRequest to fetch ProfileEnvelope.

classes.name: Details.QueryValidator
classes.description: Validates that the username in the query is not empty.

classes.name: Details.QueryHandler
classes.description: Handles the profile details request using an injected profile reader.

methods.name: Handle
methods.description: Processes the query to retrieve a profile envelope asynchronously.
